description: The text of a valid BUY frame (190 bytes, padding '==') whose last data character is changed so that the highest of its four spare bits (0x08) is not zero. It still decodes (even with validate=True) to exactly the valid frame, and sha256 is that frame's hash, so a decoder that only validates the alphabet counts the message. Under 2.2 the text is not the standard encoding of its own bytes: UNDECODABLE, RAW_HASH_MISMATCH, MALFORMED, one void, slot NONE.
title: non-canonical trailing bits, padding '=='
